nl: Enable the setting `extension=intl` in php.ini by removing the comment marker from its line. Other commented lines stay commented.
oracle_program: lines "php.ini" |> filter text == ";extension=intl" |> replace ";extension=intl" "extension=intl" mode: literal
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('php.ini')
t = p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
old = ';extension=intl\n'
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_bytes(t.replace(old, 'extension=intl\n').encode('utf-8'))
EOF
